text:
I went to this location and completed my order at the kiosk and waited. And waited.. and waited... I waited to pay for my food for 50 mins. By then the kiosk had deleted my order because I haven't paid yet. But while waiting I asked politely a few times if I could pay. But the manager proceeded to tell me to "use the kiosk" and I told him I did but I have cash and need to pay. He then tells us that nobody showed up so they can't help us. And when asking again, he says that the cars lined up outside are more important. After asking a third time, the manager with dreads started to ignore me. I still waited patiently. Mobile orders are flying off the counter. And I waited. At this point I am beginning to become furious. Finally the manager comes to the register. I tell him my order, and without pushing any buttons or even looking at the register, tells me there is no order. So I tell him I did order on the kiosk but he said there was no order. So I begin to tell him what I wanted. And he told me to use the kiosk and I asked well can I just order here real quick since your already here. He ignores me and looks to another customer and starts helping them while blatantly ignoring me while I been waiting for almost an hour now to get some food. So word of advice.
I have been disrespected at this location before, and they have gotten my order wrong before, but nothing like what I experienced today. I am usually a very patient person. But they were out of line today and I will be finding a GM to talk to.

If you go to this location DO NOT BRING CASH. Because you will not be helped...
If I could, I'd give this place 0/5 stars
And the manager I have had troubles with today I believe is named Tony. And the other guy was the one who forgets his uniform.
author: Sky Sisters

text:
I usually order through the McDonald’s mobile app because it is convenient, lets me use rewards points, and makes pickup fast. This time, I placed my order as always, confirmed the location, and went to the drive-thru. At the first window, the worker asked for my code, confirmed my name, and said “Gotchu.” Everything seemed normal.
When I got to the second window, things completely fell apart. I waited a long time, saw employees looking around for my order, and eventually someone asked me what I ordered. I showed them my app with the confirmed order and location. After more waiting, the manager came and told me she did not see my order in their system and refused to give me my food, even though my app clearly showed the order placed at that exact McDonald’s with the correct address.
I explained that if my order was not there, how did the person in the first window know my name after providing the code, since you never provide your name when ordering. Instead of resolving the issue, the manager just kept insisting I cancel the order, told me to leave, and even threatened to call the cops when I pushed back and showed proof of purchase. The app itself says to talk to the manager if there is a problem, which is what I was doing, but she was dismissive and unprofessional.
This location needs better training and accountability. The customer service was extremely poor and the way the situation was handled was unacceptable. I would strongly recommend avoiding this McDonald’s location.
author: Jorge Diaz
